findings.evidence: Preface p.14: "In the book's convention (Ch. 2, 4), TTFTe2e = retrieval + admission/queue + tokenization/transfer + prefill + first decode step, where tokenization/transfer counts as one combined term." vs Ch 2 p.35: "Written as a sum, end-to-end TTFT is TTFTe2e = retrieval + admission/queue + tokenization/transfer + prefill. It carries no separate 'first decode step' term: under the convention above, the first token's forward pass is sampled inside prefill, so a term for it would count that work twice." Ch 4 p.74 also states: "TTFT_e2e convention (used throughout): TTFTe2e = retrieval+admission/queue+tokenization/transfer + prefill."
findings.issue: Cross-chapter TTFT formula inconsistency. The Preface defines TTFTe2e with five terms including '+ first decode step' and cites '(Ch. 2, 4)' as its source, but Ch 2 and Ch 4 both give a four-term formula that explicitly excludes 'first decode step' with the rationale that it would 'count that work twice.' The Preface further says 'Those three terms are separate and positive' (referring to admission/queue, tokenization/transfer, first decode step), while under Ch 2's formula only two terms sit outside the 1.2 s budget. A reader following the Preface would misunderstand the TTFT budget structure.
findings.fix_instruction: Remove '+ first decode step' from the Preface TTFT formula on p.14 to match Ch 2 (p.35) and Ch 4 (p.74), or add a note explaining the Preface uses a different (alternative) convention than the book body. Also correct 'Those three terms' to 'Those two terms' if removing the first decode step.

findings.evidence: p.17 first paragraph: "Evidence boundary — four registers… MEASURED… ANALYTICAL… ILLUSTRATIVE — a chosen scenario input or worked example… HYPOTHESIS…" Then same page Axis note: "[ILLUSTRATIVE] is a provenance tag (Axis 1) only — a non-canonical worked example — and is never a measurement status; measurement status uses ANALYTICAL, SCENARIO-DERIVED, MODELED, MEASURED or UNMEASURED."
findings.issue: Self-contradictory label definition on a single page. The first paragraph presents ILLUSTRATIVE as one of 'four registers' alongside MEASURED, ANALYTICAL, and HYPOTHESIS, implying it is a measurement-status register. The Axis note immediately below states '[ILLUSTRATIVE] is a provenance tag (Axis 1) only…and is never a measurement status.' A reader encountering ILLUSTRATIVE in the four-registers list first would reasonably infer it is a measurement status, contradicting the clarification that follows.
findings.fix_instruction: Either remove ILLUSTRATIVE from the 'four registers' list in the first paragraph (listing it only under Axis 1 provenance), or add a forward parenthetical in the first paragraph noting it is a provenance tag, not a measurement status, so the two definitions on the page do not contradict each other.

findings.evidence: p.14: "Section cross-references use the § chapter.section form: a bare § N.M refers to chapter N, section M — so § 1.4 is Ch. 1, Section 4 (Measurement)". Actual forms used in body: 'Ch 7 §3' (p.85), 'Ch 8 §8.3.3' (p.154, redundant chapter prefix), 'Appendix A §9A' (pp.35,56,67, non-standard format not matching § N.M or Appendix A's A.N numbering).
findings.issue: Cross-reference convention on p.14 defines only one form (§ N.M), but the book uses at least three additional undocumented forms: (a) 'Ch N §M' where § is followed only by a section number (requires the 'Ch N' prefix to be unambiguous), (b) 'Ch N §N.M' which redundantly repeats the chapter number, and (c) 'Appendix A §9A' which uses a section identifier ('9A') that does not match either the § N.M convention or the Appendix A figure/section numbering pattern (A.1, A.2, etc.).
findings.fix_instruction: Extend the cross-reference convention on p.14 to document all forms actually used: § N.M for chapters, Ch N §M for named-chapter section references, and the Appendix A internal section identifier scheme (e.g. §9A). Also remove redundant chapter prefixes like 'Ch 8 §8.3.3'.

findings.evidence: p.17: "Provenance (Axis 1) records where the number came from: [1P] first-party (the model vendor's own spec), [canonical scenario] the book's own internally defined workload and model (Ch. 4, Table 4-2), [ILLUSTRATIVE] a non-canonical worked-example or scenario input chosen to make a calculation concrete, [2°] reputable second-hand (textbook, survey, independent benchmark), or [LAB] measured on the author's own home-lab hardware (illustrative of mechanism, not production)."
findings.issue: ASD-STE100 readability concern: the evidence discipline panel combines multiple definitions, axis explanations, conventions, and exceptions into single sentences separated only by semicolons and commas, with nested parentheticals. The Axis 1 definition sentence alone has five alternatives with interleaved parentheticals spanning four printed lines. Several sentences exceed 80 words with multiple embedded clauses. This is the reference panel readers must consult throughout the book, and its density increases the risk of misreading labels.
findings.fix_instruction: Break the Axis 1 definition into a bulleted list (one item per provenance label with its definition), and similarly decompose the Axis 2 and Axis 3 definitions into lists rather than running sentences with semicolon-separated clauses.

findings.evidence: Prefill latency is not interchangeable with TTFT: prefill is a component of, not identical to, the user-observed TTFT. In the book's convention (Ch. 2, 4), TTFTe2e = retrieval + admission/queue + tokenization/transfer + prefill + first decode step, where tokenization/transfer counts as one combined term.
findings.issue: The Preface states the TTFT convention as including a '+ first decode step' term, but Ch. 2 (p. 15) states the opposite convention explicitly: 'Written as a sum, end-to-end TTFT is TTFTe2e = retrieval + admission/queue + tokenization/transfer + prefill. It carries no separate 'first decode step' term: under the convention above, the first token's forward pass is sampled inside prefill, so a term for it would count that work twice.' The two formulations of the same named convention differ by one term, and the Preface's version is the superseded one (Ch. 2's is dated to the book's own timing convention).
findings.fix_instruction: Correct the Preface's formula to match Ch. 2's: 'TTFTe2e = retrieval + admission/queue + tokenization/transfer + prefill' with a note that the first token is sampled inside prefill, so no separate first-decode-step term is counted. Keep the Preface's parallel caution that 'the ~1.2 s canonical budget covers only retrieval + prefill'.

findings.evidence: Preface page 9: "9.2" and "A chronology of frontier AI systems" listed in Contents; List of Figures page 11 lists "Figure A.3 A chronology of frontier AI systems"
findings.issue: Contents vs List of Figures ontology mismatch for Figure A.3: Contents entry describes as chart but List of Figures pagination implies different location; bare pagination not verifiable against actual caption location violates anti-fabrication pagination check.
findings.fix_instruction: Verify actual caption location of Fig A.3 in Appendix A and correct List of Figures page number to match rendered PDF; ensure Contents and List of Figures use identical title string.

findings.evidence: page 13: "Cross-references. Section cross-references use the § chapter.section form: a bare § N.M refers to chapter N" — internal contradiction (calls bare § N.M yet N.M is qualified)
findings.issue: Prose clarity ASD-STE100: Preface definition of "bare § N.M" is ambiguous pronoun/term — reuses "bare" to mean qualified N.M, causing downstream validation confusion for §7 flags.
findings.fix_instruction: Rewrite Preface sentence to: "A reference §N.M means Chapter N, Section M; a bare §N without .M is malformed and must not appear"; run STE100 check for reused quantity with two meanings.
